readout-figure.purpose: Tempo, shot count, length under the monitor; 22px under 480px.

readout-word.purpose: A readout value that is a word (director in use).

title.purpose: Panel titles, with an optional muted 400-weight hint.

body-small.purpose: Tagline, shot reasoning, Changes list, empty states.

readout-label.purpose: Small muted word beside each readout figure.

print-caption.purpose: Timecode and id on a print's bottom margin, plus ' · kept' / ' · out'.

dock-label.purpose: Uppercase column labels inside the Revise dock only.

shadows.name: none
shadows.purpose: Flat system: block and input shadows are off; depth is tonal.

shadows.name: selected-ring
shadows.purpose: Selected print: a 2px red ring with a 4px lift. A state, not elevation.

motion.name: settle
motion.purpose: The one authored motion: readout values settle in when a cut lands. Off under reduced motion.

motion.name: chevron-turn
motion.purpose: Accordion chevron rotates -45deg to 45deg. Off under reduced motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one filled action on screen: Generate before a cut, Recut after, carrying the pending count.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #d22f22; color: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #d22f22; border-radius: 4px; padding: 10px 24px; font: 600 15px Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #e5402f; border-color: #e5402f; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #d22f22; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { background: #232323; color: #8f959e; border-color: #2b2b2b; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Export, Keep/Remove, Put back removed shots; Generate once a cut exists.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #232323; color: #f2f2f2; border: 1px solid #3c3c3c; border-radius: 4px; padding: 10px 24px; font: 600 15px Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #2b2b2b; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #d22f22; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:disabled { color: #8f959e; border-color: #2b2b2b; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Director's brief and the note for the editor.
components.html: <textarea class="ds-input" rows="3" placeholder="Warm, nostalgic summer recap..."></textarea>
components.css: .ds-input { width: 280px; background: #232323; color: #f2f2f2; border: 1px solid #3c3c3c; border-radius: 4px; padding: 8px 10px; font: 400 14px/1.5 Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; caret-color: #d22f22; box-shadow: none; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #8f959e; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #d22f22; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #d22f22; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Source Toggle
components.description: Radio pill choosing uploaded vs demo media or song.
components.css: .ds-toggle { display: flex; gap: 8px; } .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: #232323; color: #f2f2f2; border: 1px solid #3c3c3c; border-radius: 4px; padding: 8px 12px; font: 400 14px Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-pill input { accent-color: #d22f22; margin: 0; } .ds-pill:has(input:checked) { background: rgba(210, 47, 34, 0.16); border-color: #d22f22; } .ds-pill:has(input:focus-visible) { outline: 2px solid #d22f22; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Workspace Panel
components.description: One frame per panel; title over a hairline; blocks inside sit flat.
components.html:
Revisepick a shot, keep or remove it, add a note, then recut

Your editor's note about each cut shows up here.
components.css: .ds-panel { width: 360px; background: #1a1a1a; border: 1px solid #2b2b2b; border-radius: 6px; padding: 10px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-panel-title { margin: 0; padding-bottom: 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid #2b2b2b; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: #f2f2f2; } .ds-panel-title span { font-weight: 400; color: #9ba1a9; margin-left: 10px; } .ds-panel-body { margin: 0; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5; color: #f2f2f2; }

components.name: Readout Strip
components.description: Scale-contrast figures under the monitor; tempo is the one lit figure; values settle in when a cut lands.
components.css: .ds-readout { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: baseline; gap: 6px 32px; padding: 11px 16px; border: 1px solid #2b2b2b; border-radius: 0 0 6px 6px; background: #1a1a1a; font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-readout span { display: inline-flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 9px; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-readout em { font-style: normal; font-size: 12px; color: #9ba1a9; } .ds-readout b { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-weight: 800; font-size: 28px; letter-spacing: -.02em; color: #f2f2f2; animation: ds-settle .45s cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1) both; } .ds-readout b.lit { color: #d22f22; } .ds-readout b.word { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0; } @keyframes ds-settle { from { opacity: .25; transform: translateY(3px); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-readout b { animation: none; } }

components.name: Instant Print Row
components.description: Timeline of white prints; bottom margin holds a fixed state cell (hollow open, red kept, struck removed) and the timecode.
components.css: .ds-strip { display: flex; gap: 10px; padding: 8px 4px; background: #1a1a1a; } .ds-print { position: relative; width: 168px; aspect-ratio: 16 / 9; background: #fafafa; padding: 5px 5px 24px; border: 0; border-radius: 2px; cursor: pointer; transition: translate .2s; } .ds-img { display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; background: #5a6470; } .ds-cap { position: absolute; left: 6px; right: 6px; bottom: 4px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; color: #121212; font: 600 11px Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-cap::before { content: ""; flex: 0 0 9px; height: 9px; border: 1.5px solid #121212; } .ds-print.kept .ds-cap::before { background: #d22f22; border-color: #d22f22; } .ds-print.out .ds-cap::before { background: linear-gradient(45deg, transparent 42%, #121212 42% 58%, transparent 58%); } .ds-print.out .ds-img { opacity: .6; filter: grayscale(1); } .ds-print.selected { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #d22f22; translate: 0 -4px; } .ds-print:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #d22f22; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
Your shots are prints laid out on a dark table: pick one up, keep it or put it aside, and the music decides the order. The table is a neutral black with no warm tint; panels sit one step up on it, divided by 1px neutral hairlines. The footage itself arrives as crisp white instant prints, and the only colour the interface adds is one signal red, spent on action, selection and kept marks.

The world refuses both category defaults: the dark graphite pro editor and the pastel soft-card consumer app. It is dark in every OS colour scheme. Hierarchy comes from scale contrast (large figures, small quiet labels) and from state shown as a mark in a fixed cell, not from fills, glows or badges. Archivo carries everything, with tabular figures wherever a number can change.

Density is a workspace, not a landing page: three panels and a revise dock fit a 1440x900 viewport, and each panel draws exactly one frame so inputs inside it sit flat.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral black table, panels one step up, 1px hairlines; no warm tint.
White instant prints whose wide bottom margin carries timecode and a state cell.
One signal red for action, selection and kept; white text on red.
Archivo only; tabular figures for every number.
Small radii on panels, near-square print corners, no shadows, no glow, no gradients, no tilt.
One authored motion: readout values settle in when a cut lands.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Red is reserved for action, selection, kept marks and errors. Nothing decorative is red. A screen with nothing selected and nothing to do carries one red element at most.

rules.name: The One Lit Figure Rule
rules.body: Exactly one readout value is lit red: tempo, because the music owns timing. Every other figure stays in text colour. Do not light a second figure.

rules.name: The Neutral Table Rule
rules.body: Greys stay neutral (no warm or cool tint in surfaces). Colour on the table comes from the footage and the one red, never from the chrome.

rules.name: The Scale Contrast Rule
rules.body: In the readout, figures are large and heavy, labels small and muted, on one baseline. Hierarchy is the size gap, not colour or boxes.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every number that can change (timecode, BPM, counts, length) uses tabular figures.

rules.name: The Tonal Step Rule
rules.body: Separate surfaces with a one-step grey change and a 1px hairline, never with a shadow or glow.

dos: Do keep every surface on the neutral grey ladder (table-black, panel, input) and separate steps with 1px hairlines.
Do show footage as white prints with the timecode and state cell on the bottom margin.
Do show state as a mark in a fixed cell (hollow open, red kept, struck removed), written by the app as a caption suffix.
Do keep exactly one filled red button visible; move primary to the next decision (Generate, then Recut).
Do use tabular figures for every changing number and scale contrast for hierarchy in the readout.
Do keep the app dark regardless of the visitor's OS colour scheme.
donts: Don't use red for decoration, or light a second readout figure.
Don't add shadows, glows or gradients; the struck state cell is the only drawn diagonal.
Don't tilt prints, add handwriting, or warm-tint the greys.
Don't introduce a second typeface or a monospace face for numbers.
Don't draw a second frame inside a panel; blocks in a panel sit flat.
Don't add transitions or overlays that imply effects between shots; the only motion is the readout settle and the chevron turn.
